description.en: Original low-poly fossil-form interpretation of Paraspirifer, with a deep biconvex shell, median dorsal fold and opposing ventral sulcus. Approximately 40 mm wide; hidden depth is an artistic estimate. Approximately 40 mm width is specimen-anchored; hidden depth, posterior, color and ribs are inferred. This new candidate does not recover or inherit the lost historical revision.
description.zh: Paraspirifer 原创低多边形化石形态：深厚双凸壳、中央背褶与相对腹沟。宽约 40 毫米，隐藏厚度为艺术估计。 约40毫米宽度有标本依据，隐藏深度、后部、颜色与肋纹含推定。本次新候选不等于已找回或继承遗失历史版本。
